name: Chang'e 8
short_status: In development: CNSA's published target is a launch around 2029 to the Leibnitz-Beta Plateau (Mons Mouton) with an ISRU lunar-brick 3D-printing demo. SpaceNews reported on 10 Sep 2026 that China appears to be reconfiguring its robotic Moon program, Chang'e 8 included; no Chinese official source has announced a change (as of 2 Nov 2026).
tagline: CNSA · China · Lander · 2029 · Commercial and multipolar Planned
stats: payload capacity reserved for international partners
height of Mons Mouton, the ~100 km-wide target plateau

facts.label: Status (as of 2 Nov 2026)
facts.value: In development; launch targeted around 2029 per CNSA (announced 24 April 2025). SpaceNews reported on 10 Sep 2026 that China appears to be reconfiguring its robotic Moon program, Chang'e 8 included; no Chinese official source has announced a change, and CNSA's chief engineer said on 3 Sep 2026 that China is continuing to advance Chang'e 8

facts.label: Landing target
facts.value: Leibnitz-Beta Plateau (IAU name: Mons Mouton, ~84.6 S / 31 E, named 2022 for NASA mathematician Melba Roy Mouton); site selection narrowed to the plateau as of April 2025

facts.label: Core elements
facts.value: Lander, ~100 kg rover, and robotic units including two 5 kg micro-rovers

facts.label: ISRU headline experiment
facts.value: 3D printing bricks from lunar regolith using focused solar energy, no water or binders; DSEL (Hefei) showed a prototype brick-making machine in April 2025

facts.label: International payloads
facts.value: 10 projects selected from 41 proposals on 24 April 2025, spanning 11 countries/regions plus one international organization, within a 200 kg allocation

facts.label: Partner hardware
facts.value: Hong Kong multi-functional robot with mobile charging station; Pakistani rover (~35 kg, MoU 5 Feb 2025); Turkish micro-rovers; South Africa-Peru radio astronomy array; Italian laser retroreflector; Russian plasma-dust analyzer; Thai neutron analyzer; Bahrain-Egypt imager; Iranian lunar potential monitor

facts.label: ILRS role
facts.value: Chang'e 7 + Chang'e 8 form the ILRS 'basic model'; ILRS counted 17 countries/international organizations and 50+ institutions as of April 2025, with construction planned for the 2030s

facts.label: Neighborhood
facts.value: Mons Mouton already hosts IM-2 Athena (landed on its side at 84.7906 S in March 2025) and is the planned VIPER landing region
